name: Recall Visions
body:
Once per day you are able to recall a divination spell you have cast.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Focus (divination), 5th-level loremaster, ability to cast prepared spells

Benefit: Once per day as a standard action, you are able to recall any one divination spell you had prepared and then cast that day. This spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast. The spell may be of any level and it is recalled with the same metamagic feats applied to it during its first casting.
